name: Eval-O-Matic
description: Eval-O-Matic is a benchmark consisting of 500 challenging open-ended prompts curated automatically from large crowdsourced datasets using the Bench-O-Matic pipeline. It measures the ability of language models to handle difficult prompts and aligns well with human preferences, providing a scalable framework for continuous benchmark curation.
reputation: Provides 3x higher separation of model performances compared to MT-Bench and achieves 98.6% correlation with human preference rankings.
notes: Automated benchmark curation from crowdsourced data with LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation; cost-effective and scalable.
